about:
Evergreen Plastic Container (EPC) operates from Vancouver, Washington, where it manufactures PET (polyethylene terephthalate) containers for food and beverage applications. The company provides full-service packaging solutions that span product design, engineering, and ongoing support.

EPC produces PET bottles, preforms, closures, and custom blow molds, and offers prototype design and development. Its capabilities cover both short-run and long-run production, and the company describes itself as a full-service integrated operation that manages the entire production process from start to finish. Color printing is available for decoration and marketing purposes.

The company serves food and beverage manufacturers and other businesses requiring plastic packaging. It works with customers on custom packages as well as stock components, and emphasizes individualized service for each account.

EPC positions itself as a One Stop Packaging Center (OSPC), highlighting its ability to handle design, tooling, and production under one roof. The company states that it aims to exceed expectations by applying its own high standards and by offering both custom tooling and readily available stock items.
